description: This file defines the 'Module' class within the Opencart admin model setting namespace. It provides methods for managing module records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving modules, as well as deleting modules by code and associated layout data.
external_files: database connection and query execution (implied by $this->db)

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A class for managing module records in the Opencart admin setting context, including CRUD operations and related database interactions.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Creates a new module record in the database with specified code and data.

methods.name: editModule
methods.description: Updates an existing module record identified by module_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module record from the database by module_id.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes all modules with a specific code and associated layout modules.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a module record by module_id, decoding its settings.

methods.name: getModulesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves all modules matching a specific code.
